requirements.summary: Create a frontend admin utility that automatically fetches all data from the live canister and imports it into the draft canister when triggered, implementing the complete sync workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend implements logic to call live canister export functions
Frontend calls draft canister import functions with exported data
Sync process handles both Nakshatra text data and image blobs
Sync shows progress feedback to admin users
Error handling provides clear messages if sync fails

file_operations.description: Create a React Query mutation hook that orchestrates the complete sync workflow: 1) Connect to live canister using environment variable for canister ID, 2) Call exportNakshatraData() and exportImageData() on live canister, 3) Call importNakshatraData() and importImageData() on draft canister with the exported data, 4) Track progress through sync stages (exporting Nakshatras, exporting images, importing Nakshatras, importing images), 5) Handle errors at each stage with descriptive messages, 6) Return sync completion status and timestamp, 7) Invalidate relevant React Query caches on success

Create configuration utility that exports functions to get live and draft canister IDs from environment variables (VITE_LIVE_CANISTER_ID and VITE_CANISTER_ID), with validation to ensure both are configured before sync operations, and a helper to create an actor instance for the live canister using the same authentication context

requirements.summary: Add a 'Sync from Live' button in the admin panel that triggers the automatic data synchronization from live to draft, displaying sync progress and completion status
acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel includes a clearly labeled sync button
Button shows loading state during sync operation
Success message confirms when sync completes
Error messages display if sync fails with actionable guidance

file_operations.description: Create a button component that triggers the sync mutation from useSyncFromLive hook, displays the current sync stage as progress text (e.g., 'Exporting Nakshatras...', 'Importing images...'), shows a loading spinner during sync, and displays success toast on completion or error toast with detailed message on failure. Include confirmation dialog before starting sync to warn that all draft data will be replaced.

Add the SyncFromLiveButton component to the admin page header area, positioned prominently above the Nakshatra grid. Import and render the new component with appropriate spacing and visual prominence to make it easily discoverable for admin users.

requirements.summary: Update the AdminPage to display sync status information showing when the last sync occurred and whether draft data is in sync with live data
acceptanceCriteria: Admin page shows timestamp of last successful sync
UI indicates if draft data differs from live data
Sync status updates automatically after sync operations complete

file_operations.description: Create a status display component that shows: 1) Last sync timestamp from localStorage (formatted as relative time like '2 hours ago'), 2) Visual indicator of sync status (green checkmark if recently synced, yellow warning if stale or never synced), 3) Automatically updates when sync completes by listening to custom events from the sync mutation, 4) Uses card layout with subtle styling to display sync metadata without overwhelming the page

Add the SyncStatusDisplay component to the admin page, positioned near the SyncFromLiveButton to create a cohesive sync management section. Render the status display component with appropriate layout spacing.

Update the sync mutation to store the last successful sync timestamp in localStorage (key: 'lastSyncTimestamp') and dispatch a custom event ('syncCompleted') when sync finishes successfully, allowing the SyncStatusDisplay component to reactively update without prop drilling
